text: {"name":"wlc_scan_entry_find_or_alloc","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Searches the three-entry scan table for a compatible record, updates it when its tag advances, or initializes a free slot and returns its identifier through the output pointer.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"entry_data","a2":"slot_id_out","v2":"slot_table_base","v5":"slot_record","i":"slot_index","v7":"free_slot_record","v8":"allocated_slot_id","v11":"stored_tag","v12":"incoming_tag","v13":"matched_slot_record"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Entry data begins here; the byte at this offset is compared with input byte 0."},{"offset":5,"meaning":"Tag byte compared with input byte 1 and advanced when the incoming tag is newer."},{"offset":6,"meaning":"16-bit match component compared with input bytes 2–3."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit entry component compared on equal tags and refreshed when the tag advances."},{"offset":10,"meaning":"16-bit entry component compared on equal tags and refreshed when the tag advances."},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Trailing 16-bit input value copied when a free slot is initialized."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Slot identifier/validity byte; 0xff denotes an empty slot."}]}
